title: Pinpoint Global Website
description: Company website for a branding, marketing and packaging company with headquarters in Abuja
longDescription: Built a modern, responsive company website for Pinpoint Global showcasing their services and portfolio.
challenge: Create a professional web presence that showcases Pinpoint Global's branding and marketing services while maintaining fast load times.
solution: Built with Next.js for optimal performance, used Tailwind CSS for responsive design, and implemented image optimization for gallery-heavy content.
results: Improved online presence, fast loading times with Core Web Vitals in the green, professional design aligned with brand identity.

title: ZedApp Website
description: Landing page and marketing website for ZedApp
longDescription: Designed and built a compelling landing page for ZedApp that converts visitors and showcases product features.
challenge: Create an engaging landing page that highlights ZedApp's unique value proposition and drives sign-ups.
solution: Implemented scroll animations, optimized CTAs, used compelling copy and visuals, integrated analytics for conversion tracking.
results: High engagement metrics, improved conversion rate, strong SEO performance, fast page load times.

title: Crelyst Agency Website
description: Full-stack website for Crelyst, a creative design and branding agency specialising in photography, brand design, and visual identity
longDescription: Built a full-stack agency website with a comprehensive admin panel for managing services, projects, testimonials, and site settings — all without requiring client code deploys.
challenge: Build a production-ready agency website with full content management capabilities, media storage, and performance at scale.
solution: Implemented Next.js 16 with RSC for performance, MongoDB for flexible content storage, Redis for caching, Cloudflare R2 for media, and a full admin panel with JWT authentication.
results: Zero-deploy content updates, fast page loads with Redis-cached responses, scalable media handling via R2, and a clean CMS the client operates independently.

title: The SHE Initiative Landing Page
description: Landing page for The Solace Healing and Empowerment Initiative, a nonprofit focused on women empowerment in tech
longDescription: Created a compelling landing page for a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering women in technology.
challenge: Build a website that effectively communicates the organization's mission and encourages donations and volunteer sign-ups.
solution: Focused on clear messaging, used testimonials and impact metrics, implemented donation integration, optimized for accessibility.
results: Strong mission communication, improved volunteer engagement, easy donation flow, high accessibility score.

title: Lendsqr Users Dashboard
description: Mock admin dashboard for Lendsqr, featuring user management and analytics
longDescription: Built a comprehensive admin dashboard with user filtering, pagination, and detailed user management capabilities.
challenge: Create a complex data-heavy dashboard that displays user information with advanced filtering and sorting capabilities.
solution: Implemented efficient state management, optimized data fetching, built reusable table components, added comprehensive filtering and pagination.
results: Smooth user experience despite large datasets, fast sorting and filtering, clean UI that scales with data volume.

title: NAFHCC Public Website
description: Public website for the Nigerian Air Force Housing and Construction Company, showcasing residential estates and housing services nationwide
longDescription: Built the public-facing website for NAFHCC, enabling prospective home owners to browse estates, search properties by location and type, and understand the path to home ownership.
challenge: Create a trustworthy, content-rich property showcase for a government-affiliated housing company with estates across multiple Nigerian states.
solution: Built with Next.js for fast static and server-rendered pages, implemented property search and filtering, estate detail pages, and a clear four-step home ownership journey.
results: Professional web presence for a national housing institution, fast property discovery with search and filters, and clear trust signals across service pages.

title: M&G Cleaning Services Website
description: Customer-facing website for a professional cleaning services company covering homes, offices, upholstery, and post-construction spaces
longDescription: Built the full customer-facing website for M&G Cleaning Services, with a focus on trust, clear service communication, and an easy enquiry flow — backed by a Hono API and deployed on Coolify.
challenge: Build a professional service website that converts visitors into enquiries, communicates the M&G brand, and scales with business growth.
solution: Implemented Next.js 16 frontend with a separate Hono backend, Playwright E2E tests, Docker containerisation, and a Coolify-based deployment pipeline.
results: Clean, conversion-focused website with a 15-minute response promise, 24-hour follow-up system, and a fully automated deployment workflow.

title: EyeConnect Landing Page
description: Landing page for the EyeConnect Initiative, connecting patients with eye care specialists
longDescription: Built a healthcare-focused landing page that facilitates connections between patients and vision care specialists.
challenge: Create a healthcare landing page that builds trust, clearly communicates services, and drives patient sign-ups.
solution: Emphasized credibility with specialist profiles, integrated appointment booking, focused on accessibility for vision-impaired users.
results: High trust signals, improved appointment booking rate, accessible to users with vision impairments, professional healthcare branding.
